blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Department of Tourism in Central Visayas (DOT-7) is urging tourism-related businesses and service providers to secure accreditation and take advantage of the waiver of processing fees and streamlined documentation requirements. DOT-7 OIC Director Gelena Asis-Dimpas said accreditation offers businesses various opportunities to grow and expand their operations. “Accreditation opens up […]...
